page.layout: One page of text in a single main column with a running head above and a narrow blank right margin; faint show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed; catchword "aucti" at the foot right.

main_text.head: SECT. XIV. De Canone Scripturæ.

p.i: Nunc demum (ne nimius sim) ab his quæ nosmetipsos non oblique spectare mihi visa sunt, festino ad ea, quæ Deum ipsum propius attingunt, haftamq; in cœli terminos minaciter conijciunt. Ea vero siue Scripturam verbum Dei θεόπνευστον; seu Christum, verbum ἔμφυτον, seu deniq; cultum diuinæ maiestati debitum respiciunt.

main_text.p: Et scripturæ quidem dica triplex impingi solet, eaq; profecto grauis, grandisq;. Prima

page.notes: The Greek words θεόπνευστον and ἔμφυτον are reproduced from the print as best read; the first is partly worn. The right margin carries faint, illegible show-through only and no legible marginal notes. Fragmentary text at the top (from the reverse page) is not transcribed.
